title: A viral social media post from a Chinese math teacher sparks debate over making English optional in schools across China especially as AI translation improves (New York Times)
summary: New York Times: A viral social media post from a Chinese math teacher sparks debate over making English optional in schools across China especially as AI translation improves — A math teacher's viral post prompted a debate over the language, which some see as an optional skill — and a symbol of Western dominance.
